Name: Nested group membership
Description: Lists every group that is a member of another group, and which group(s) it is a member of - one row per group/parent pair, marked Direct or Inherited (via a chain of nested groups). The admin center only shows this one group at a time. Read-only; run it once per tenant and combine the CSVs on the TenantId column.
Author: M365 Admin Toolkit

Parameters.Name: IncludeInherited
Parameters.Label: Include inherited parents
Parameters.HelpText: Also list parent groups reached through other groups (A in B, B in C: A is listed under C as Inherited, with the path)

Parameters.Name: LimitToGroups
Parameters.Label: Only these groups (optional)
Parameters.HelpText: Leave empty for the whole tenant. Otherwise one group display name or object id per line; only rows for these member groups are shown.
